title: C-Calculus / Governed Binding Stack v0.1: Operational Algebra for c = a + b, Continuity, Self-Evolution, Runtime Authority, Public Evidence, Interoperability, Deployment, and Protected Plus Boundary
description: This package contains the CCALC / C-calculus governed binding stack v0.1. It defines a typed, governed operational stack for c = a + b. It treats + as a governed non-collapsing binding boundary and protects it from reduction to b. It includes continuity, self-evolution, runtime authority, public evidence, interoperability, deployment/release, and plus-boundary layers.
